articles.title: SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants as demand soars
articles.description: Memory prices have surged because of short supply and huge demand with investors watching closely for any changes to the supply-demand imbalance.

articles.title: Volkswagen controlling families call for faster overhaul to fend off Chinese rivals
articles.description: Volkswagen's top investor on Friday called on the auto giant to take immediate action to fend off intensifying competition from Chinese car brands.

articles.title: Ethereum staking token weETH splits from restaking as rewards debate heats up
articles.description: The move separates ordinary Ethereum staking from higher-risk restaking exposure as a new proposal to cap validator rewards divides the staking sector.

articles.title: Coldcard exploit pushes July losses to $247M as second-worst month of 2026
articles.description: The Coldcard exploit, which caused more than $100 million in losses, helped push July crypto thefts to $247 million, making it the second-worst month of 2026.

articles.title: Europe’s wildfire ‘protection gap’ is growing, insurers warn
articles.description: Insurers warn that Europe is facing a "protection gap" in wildfire cover as disaster recovery costs outpace insurance coverage.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin flat at $64,300 before US jobs report, with oil back as a headwind
articles.description: Brent climbed on stalled Hormuz talks, reviving the inflation worry that has capped bitcoin all summer. Today's US payrolls print is the next catalyst.

articles.title: China's exports growth beats estimates in July, as AI-driven shipments surge
articles.description: China's exports rose more than expected in July, as global demand for high-tech components continues to absorb the country's manufactured goods.

articles.title: Bitcoin whales load up on $1.2 billion in BTC as ETFs attract $750 million
articles.description: Bitcoin whales accumulate $1.2 billion in BTC while spot ETFs pull in $754 million this week.

articles.title: Oil rises as Iran's draft plan sees U.S. and Israel banned from Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: News of Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices higher, renewing concerns over supply disruptions.

articles.title: Japan FSA asks crypto exchanges to impose withdrawal delays to fight scams
articles.description: Japanese authorities called for address registration, customer-specific limits and stronger authentication as part of a broader push to curb misuse of exchange accounts.

articles.title: Proposed CLARITY ethics deal could save Trump millions in taxes: Bloomberg
articles.description: The latest bipartisan ethics proposal would reportedly require Trump to divest crypto businesses while allowing him to defer capital gains taxes on those sales.

articles.title: Bitcoin wallet dormant since 2011 moves $3.2 million toward FalconX-linked address
articles.description: The 50 BTC remained in the receiving address Friday, but that wallet has previously sent funds to FalconX-labeled deposits, leaving open whether the old stash is being reorganized or moved closer to a trading venue.

articles.title: A bitcoin pattern taking shape right now could send prices soaring to $76,000
articles.description: Bitcoin's chart is quietly tracing out a bullish setup technical analysts watch closely. But it isn't confirmed, and one key level will decide if it plays out.

articles.title: XRP leads majors losses as Clarity Act vote slips to September
articles.description: Bitcoin, ether showed slight losses while Ripple-linked XRP fell 5.5% on the week, the worst of the majors, as the Senate left Washington without taking up the market structure bill.

articles.title: The 72-hour crisis that could upend Meta’s business in India as firm risks losing legal protection
articles.description: U.S. social media giant Meta is facing increasing pressure from Indian regulators, including demands to revoke the firm's safe harbor immunity in the country.

articles.title: Bitget explores licensed crypto presence in Bhutan
articles.description: Crypto exchange Bitget has signed an agreement with Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority to pursue a regulated local presence.

articles.title: US Senate pushes CLARITY Act vote to September
articles.description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune confirmed that the chamber was “punting” the vote until September.

articles.title: MARA swings to Q2 loss as Bitcoin’s slump masks higher output
articles.description: Bitcoin miner MARA posted its highest quarterly Bitcoin production in over a year, but was overshadowed by a 28% decline in the average price of Bitcoin.

articles.title: Senate won't vote on crypto Clarity Act before its summer break
articles.description: The U.S. Senate won't go on its August recess just yet but it will not vote on the Clarity Act this month, dimming hopes that the bill can become law this year.

articles.title: Iran's chief negotiator accuses Trump of 'theater diplomacy' with Hormuz traffic near standstill
articles.description: The conflict is broadening across the region, with Gulf energy infrastructure and key shipping chokepoints under renewed threat.
